# DIFL — Dante Institute of Foreign Languages, Jaipur

Last reviewed: 30 September 2026

This file summarises the public information on mydifl.com for search and AI systems. The canonical website pages linked below remain the source of truth.

## Important accuracy note

Exam dates, fees, test centres, visa rules, immigration criteria, scholarship conditions and application procedures can change. Readers should confirm all time-sensitive details with the relevant government, embassy, examination body, university or official programme website before acting. DIFL provides language education and general guidance; it does not guarantee an examination result, job, salary, admission, scholarship, invitation or visa. Course timelines are estimates and vary with the learner's starting point, target, attendance and practice.

## Institute

Dante Institute of Foreign Languages (DIFL) is a foreign-language institute in Jaipur, Rajasthan. DIFL states that it was founded in 1970 by Late Dr. V K Sharma and teaches learners in Jaipur and online.

- Website: https://mydifl.com/
- Address: 2/11, DIFL House, Near Mama ka Hotel, Jawahar Nagar, Jaipur 302004, Rajasthan, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 99295 15151
- Contact page: https://mydifl.com/contact/
- Smart learning portal: https://mybhasha.com/
- Class formats: online, offline in Jaipur and hybrid, subject to current batch availability

## Teaching approach

DIFL calls its teaching approach TTP (Thought Translation Process). It uses the learner's familiar language as a structured bridge while developing listening, speaking, reading, writing, vocabulary and grammar through guided practice. The amount of bridge-language support is gradually reduced as the learner becomes more confident in the target language. Individual progress varies.

- Teaching method: https://mydifl.com/about-us/difl-teaching-method/
- About DIFL: https://mydifl.com/about-us/

## Language courses

### French

French classes can include practical communication, grammar, listening, reading and writing, with preparation relevant to DELF, DALF, TEF Canada or TCF Canada when appropriate. Official examination and immigration requirements must be checked with the relevant authority.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-french/

### Japanese

Japanese classes can include speaking, listening, reading, writing, kana, kanji and preparation relevant to JLPT levels. Learners should confirm the current requirements for programmes such as MEXT, TITP or SSW with the official organisation.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-japanese/

### German

German classes can include practical communication and preparation relevant to Goethe, telc or TestDaF examinations. Language requirements for Ausbildung, study, employment or visas depend on the institution, employer and official route.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-german/

### Spanish

Spanish classes can include practical speaking, listening, reading, writing and preparation relevant to DELE or SIELE. A suitable target level is selected after discussing the learner's current ability and goal.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-spanish/

### Mandarin Chinese

Mandarin classes can be planned around practical speaking or a broader programme including characters, reading, writing and preparation relevant to HSK or HSKK. The exact course emphasis depends on the learner's goals.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-mandarin-chinese/

### Arabic

Arabic classes can include Modern Standard Arabic, practical communication, script and cultural context. Current formats and any examination preparation should be confirmed with DIFL before enrolment.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-arabic/

### Korean

Korean classes can include Hangul, grammar, practical communication, reading, writing and preparation relevant to TOPIK or EPS-TOPIK. GKS and employment requirements must be verified on official programme websites.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-korean-language/

### Italian

Italian classes can include practical communication, grammar, reading, writing and preparation relevant to CILS, CELI or PLIDA when appropriate.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-italian-language/

### Russian

Russian classes can include Cyrillic, practical communication, grammar, reading, writing and preparation relevant to TORFL/TRKI where appropriate.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-russian-language/

### English

English classes can be adapted for spoken communication, academic or professional goals and preparation relevant to IELTS, TOEFL or OET. The programme and estimated duration depend on an initial discussion of the learner's needs.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-english/

### Thai

Thai classes can include practical communication, tones, script, reading, writing and cultural context. Current batch and individual-class options should be confirmed directly with DIFL.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-thai-language/

### Hindi for foreigners

Hindi classes for non-Hindi speakers can include conversational Hindi, Devanagari, reading, writing and cultural context for personal, professional or travel goals.

Course page: https://mydifl.com/learn-hindi-language/

All courses: https://mydifl.com/learn-foreign-languages/

DIFL offers language preparation and general guidance connected with selected international study or training pathways. Admission, scholarship and visa decisions remain with the relevant institutions and authorities.
